title: A frustrating commute
known_facts: No one caused the delay deliberately
opening_case: A delayed bus makes a person late for a nonurgent appointment.

nodes.prompt: A delayed bus makes a person late for a nonurgent appointment. Choose your first response.

choices.text: Notify the other party and request a new time
choices.rationale: This preserves a possible evidence-gathering route.

choices.text: Use the delay to reconsider scheduling buffers
choices.rationale: This is another plausible route; later options may change the result.

nodes.prompt: The other party is understanding. Next?

choices.text: Arrange the next time and revise planning
choices.rationale: Consider practical limits, context and autonomy.

choices.text: Assume future delays can never bother you
choices.rationale: Consider whether a broad interpretation exceeds the evidence.

nodes.prompt: The route is often late. Next?

choices.text: Try a different schedule if feasible
choices.rationale: Consider whether an additional observation is possible.

choices.text: Blame yourself for all transit problems
choices.rationale: Consider what remains unknown and who else is affected.

nodes.hypothetical_consequence: One helpful response does not mean future frustration is abnormal.
nodes.tradeoff: This is a possible result, not a prediction. Even careful decisions can produce mixed outcomes because other people, resources and circumstances matter.
